payload.title: Cowork cron session tool-staleness — pre-flight detection + reload
payload.problem: Long-lived cowork cron sessions born before/during an MCP reload never refresh their tool list. The mcp__claude_ai_gateway__call_tool wrapper goes absent in that session while the gateway is healthy fleet-wide. Symptom recurs: (1) tnb-c83 2026-05-29 false 'gateway unavailable' escalation (gateway verified healthy same minute); (2) cowork DUPLICATE-PUBLISH 2026-05-29 (spawn-retry under transport lag). Flow-level mitigation shipped in tnb bootstrap.md (commit d491191a) — diagnosis now correct, but the session still must EXIT and wait for the next tick.
payload.proposal: Assess a session-bootstrap pre-flight: introspect available tool names at cowork session start; if mcp__claude_ai_gateway__call_tool is absent, abort-and-signal for a session reload (not a silent exit), so the cycle can actually run rather than wait a full tick. Decide whether this belongs in cowork session bootstrap vs per-agent definition.
